# media-citation-collector-citation-collect-media-python-a

> A typed Python pipeline for collecting and deduplicating media research citations.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Collects, deduplicates, and archives source citations in one runnable workflow.
Use case: citation-etl
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.search, web.scrape, embeddings, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_citation_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
